title: fix: opendrt hue uniforms are vec4

commit.merge_subject: merge: fix: opendrt hue uniforms are vec4

description: The tail-drt shader declares uDrtHueR..Y as vec4 but the uniform fold wrote them with glUniform2f: a type mismatch that raised GL_INVALID_OPERATION (0x0502) at the tail-drt draw on the device (found by the first v2-sweep run). They now use glUniform4f (x, y, 0, 0). The draw then completes, but the GPU OpenDRT output does NOT match the CPU reference (v2 sweep: drt-sdr max 149 levels / 98.05% mismatch, drt-hlg 30 / 94.54%, nodes+drt 156 / 97.27%), so OpenDRT stays on the CPU in the editor's GPU arm and the encoded door (their guards are untouched). The numeric port needs debugging or the baked-LUT route (bake OpenDRT to a 3D LUT on the CPU, apply through the 0-LSB LUT stage, CPU reference uses the same LUT).
changed: fix: opendrt hue uniforms are vec4
